How are Text to Video models ranked on this leaderboard? Models are ranked using an Elo rating system derived from user votes in blind comparisons in the Artificial Analysis Video Arena. Users compare two videos generated from the same text prompt without knowing which model created each video. Higher Elo scores indicate a model is preferred more often.
